Subject: Flat 24, 150 Copperfield Walk, Kingshaven, ZZ3 7ZZ – bedroom window (ref R/PM047-1)

Good afternoon,

Following our email of 22 February: the tenant has since told us the toilet blockage has been sorted out, so no plumber is needed.

The tenant still reports that the bedroom window is not closing properly. We'd like to send one of our contractors to inspect it and either repair it or give a quote. We don't have a cost yet; if the repair goes beyond a simple fix, we'll send you the quote to approve before any further work.

Please reply APPROVE for us to send our contractor, or DECLINE. If you'd rather use your own contractor, please send us their name and contact details.

Kind regards,
Donna
Maintenance team

input.body:
Hello,

Thank you for letting us know the toilet is fixed. We're pleased your mother was able to sort it out. We've let the landlord know that only the bedroom window now needs attention, and asked for their go-ahead to send a contractor. We'll update you by 26 February.

One question so we can decide how quickly this needs doing: can the window still be shut and locked securely at the moment, and can anyone get in through it from outside (for example, is it on the ground floor or next to a balcony or flat roof)? If it can't be secured, please reply or call us straight away.

Kind regards,
Donna
Maintenance team
